system.description: This Skill is used for throwing objects like a football or dynamite. You can Throw an object that weighs up to your STR in pounds at a distance of up to your STR x10 feet. If you want to Throw a heavier or bulkier item, you do so with Disadvantage. To hit a target area, make an Unopposed Skill Check. To hit a foe with an object, make an Attack Skill Check vs. the target's Evade. On Fail, roll 1d8 for direction; the amount the Skill Check missed by is the distance away in feet it lands.

upgrades.description: You have Advantage when Throwing to a target who wants to catch what you are selling.
Choose the direction on a miss, rather than roll.
Your Throw range is your STR x20 feet.
